name: Killing In War
overview: Scripture upholds the sanctity of life with the command 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13), yet it also recognizes just consequences such as 'life for life' in cases of harm (Exodus 21:23). The law distinguishes between unlawful killing and situations where death results from defending property (Exodus 22:2). While the Old Testament includes instances where God directs actions in war (Numbers 31:1), the New Testament calls believers to a higher standard of love, urging them to love enemies and pray for persecutors rather than seek retaliation (Matthew 5:38, 44).
